self.title: Cycle 29 · Synthesis of Operational Criteria for Physical Records

detail.title: Synthesis of Operational Criteria for Physical Records
detail.summary: This cycle completes the initial synthesis of operational criteria for objective, robust, and accessible physical records. Findings confirm that environmental redundancy—broadcast through einselection—is necessary for objectivity, while effective accessibility depends on observer-specific aperture functions within the A/R/F framework.

detail.title: Robustness of Physical Records
detail.summary: Robustness occurs when multiple independent observers arrive at consistent records of system states. This consistency is secured by the stability of einselected states which minimize decoherence and environmental noise.
